reasoning: This is a Phase I dose-escalation trial of a triple combination (SHR-1802 + camrelizumab + famitinib) in advanced solid tumors. The trial was terminated early due to 'adjustment of R&D strategy' with only 25 patients enrolled over a planned 2-year duration. No primary endpoints were met, no efficacy data reported, and no safety signals documented. The lack of target identification for SHR-1802 and absence of any mechanistic data makes it impossible to assess target engagement or pathway modulation. The early termination for strategic reasons rather than safety or futility suggests a commercial decision rather than scientific failure, though the complete absence of any reported data prevents meaningful mechanistic analysis.
